# Preference: Code Style

## Statement

Alex prefers short, well-named functions with minimal comments. Code should be self-explanatory.

## Context

Functions should do one thing and be short enough to read on one screen.
Comments are avoided unless the logic is non-obvious or there is a workaround.
Naming should be explicit and descriptive rather than abbreviated.
Alex follows the principle that good names make documentation unnecessary.
